For maintenance preparation, the applicable specified procedures should cover three domains: supervision of operating conditions, supply or replacement of lubricants, and regular periodic inspection [EV-I01-005]. This material cannot choose the actual maintenance interval: the card provides no interval, product, amount, or executable procedure, and states that generic web content must not replace equipment/OEM documents [EV-I01-005]. The 'normal' class and the no-fault scenario are caller-assigned teaching assumptions, not observations or classifier inferences, and the evidence scope is registered generic bearing education only, with no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization [EV-I01-005].

Evidence limitations:
The card supplies no maintenance interval, lubricant product, dose, or step-by-step procedure, so no actual interval can be selected from it [EV-I01-005].
Generic web material must not substitute for equipment/OEM documentation [EV-I01-005].
Scope is generic bearing education only; no transfer validation to CWRU artificial defects or aviation equipment, and no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization [EV-I01-005].
The 'normal' predicted class and no-fault cause are independently specified teaching assumptions, not source-proven sample facts or classifier output [EV-I01-005].
This is an offline model source/condition review of an exposed source, not expert certification, blind testing, or formal release [EV-I01-005].
